privacy_policy.text: id="PAGE_SECTIONStr0ku" class="PAGE_SECTIONStr0ku ooGRUo" data-main-content-parent="true"> Privacy Policy Effective Date: February 16, 2026 ​ Triple J Landscaping (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us through our website, https://triplejlandscaping.net ​ This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information. ​ 1. How We Use Your Information We use the information we collect to: Respond to inquiries and provide estimates Schedule consultations and services Communicate with you regarding requested services Improve our website and services Maintain internal business records Comply with legal obligations We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. ​ 3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies Our website may use cookies or similar tracking technologies to enhance user experience and analyze site traffic. Cookies help us: Understand visitor behavior Improve website functionality Monitor website performance You can adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies if you prefer. ​ 4. Your Privacy Rights Depending on your state of residence, you may have rights to: Request access to the personal information we hold about you Request correction or deletion of your information Opt out of marketing communications To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below. ​ 7. Children’s Privacy Our website and services are not directed toward children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. ​ 8. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. ​ 9. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact: Triple J Landscaping Phone: 385-227-5475 Website: https://triplejlandscaping.net

Our goal is simple: make outdoor spaces more beautiful, functional, and enjoyable — without headaches for you. From custom landscape design and installation to lawn maintenance, irrigation systems, and hardscape features, our team handles every detail with care. Whether you need a small upgrade or a full outdoor transformation, we tailor each project to fit your space, style, and long-term goals. Decades of Combined Experience With years of hands-on experience in outdoor construction and property care, our team brings skill and efficiency to every job. We’ve refined our process to ensure projects stay organized, on schedule, and built to last. From simple lawn improvements to complete landscape renovations, we apply the same level of precision and craftsmanship every time. accessibility_statement.title: ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT | Triple J Lanscaping
accessibility_statement.meta: Read the Accessibility Statement for Triple J Landscaping and learn about our commitment to providing an inclusive, accessible website experience.
accessibility_statement.text: id="PAGE_SECTIONSmavlf" class="PAGE_SECTIONSmavlf ooGRUo" data-main-content-parent="true"> Accessibility Statement This statement was last updated on February 16, 2026 . Triple J Landscaping is committed to ensuring that our website is accessible to everyone, including individuals with disabilities. We strive to provide a positive user experience for all visitors and continuously work to make our online content easy to navigate and understand. Measures to Support Accessibility We are actively working to improve the accessibility of our website by: • Following industry best practices for website accessibility • Using clear, easy-to-understand page structure and navigation • Providing readable fonts, sufficient contrast, and intuitive layouts • Adding alternative text to images and meaningful links • Ensuring forms on our site are easy to complete and understand Ongoing Efforts While we strive to make our website accessible, we recognize that accessibility is an ongoing effort. We regularly review and update our site as technology and accessibility standards evolve. Third-Party Content Some elements of our website may include content provided by third parties. While we work to ensure accessibility across our site, we are not always able to control the accessibility of content hosted by external websites or third-party tools. Contact Us for Assistance If you experience any difficulty accessing information or using features on this website, please contact us: ​ Triple J Landscaping Phone: 385-227-5475 Website: https://triplejlandscaping.net ​ Please include a description of the specific issue you encountered, and we will make every reasonable effort to assist you promptly. Technical Standards This accessibility statement is based on current guidelines and standards, including the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, and reflects our ongoing commitment to accessibility. Need Help? If you have suggestions, questions, or concerns about the accessibility of this website, we welcome your feedback. Your input helps us improve the experience for all visitors.
